description: Removes an email address from the notification recipients list. Rules that included this address stop delivering to it. Irreversible — to use the same address again, it must be added and confirmed once more.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: notification_email_remove
title: Remove notification email
